text_en: David consulted with the commanders of the thousands and of the hundreds, with every leader.
text_cn: 达味与千夫长、百夫长并所有的官员商议后，

text_en: David said to the whole assembly of Israel, “If it seems good to you, and if it is the will of the Lord our God, let us send abroad to our kindred who remain in all the land of Israel, including the priests and Levites in the cities that have pasture lands, that they may come together to us.
text_cn: 就对以色列全会众说：“如果你们认为好，如果这事是出于上主我们的天主，我们可派遣人，去见留在以色列各地其余的弟兄，及寄居在城郊的司祭和肋未人，召集他们到我们这里来，

text_en: Then let us bring again the ark of our God to us; for we did not turn to it in the days of Saul. ”
text_cn: 为将我们天主的约柜运到我们这里，因为在撒乌耳时，我们从没有关心过它。”

text_en: The whole assembly agreed to do so, for the thing pleased all the people.
text_cn: 全会众都说应该这样行，因为这件事众百姓都认为合理。

text_en: So David assembled all Israel from the Shihor of Egypt to Lebo-hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim.
text_cn: 达味遂由埃及小河至哈玛特关口，将所有的以色列人召来，要将天主的约柜从克黎雅特耶阿陵运回来。

text_en: And David and all Israel went up to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath-jearim, which belongs to Judah, to bring up from there the ark of God, the Lord , who is enthroned on the cherubim, which is called by his name.
text_cn: 达味率领以色列民众到了巴阿拉，即犹大的克黎雅特耶阿陵，要从那里将天主的约柜运上来，这约柜名叫“坐于革鲁宾上的上主。”

text_en: They carried the ark of God on a new cart, from the house of Abinadab, and Uzzah and Ahio were driving the cart.
text_cn: 他们由阿彼纳达布家将天主的约柜抬出，放在一辆新车上，乌匝和阿希约驾车；

text_en: David and all Israel were dancing before God with all their might, with song and lyres and harps and tambourines and cymbals and trumpets.
text_cn: 达味和全以色列人在天主前，尽力舞蹈，随着弹琴、拉弦、敲鼓、击钹（bó）、鸣号的节奏讴歌；

text_en: When they came to the threshing floor of Chidon, Uzzah put out his hand to hold the ark, for the oxen shook it.
text_cn: 来近基冬禾场时，因为牛将天主的约柜倾倒，乌匝便伸手扶住；

text_en: The anger of the Lord was kindled against Uzzah; he struck him down because he put out his hand to the ark; and he died there before God.
text_cn: 因为他伸手扶了约柜，上主遂向乌匝发怒，将他击杀，他便当下死在天主面前。

text_en: David was angry because the Lord had burst out against Uzzah; so that place is called Perez-uzzah to this day.
text_cn: 达味因为上主击杀了乌匝，很觉悲伤，遂给那地方起名叫“培勒兹乌匝”，直到今日。

text_en: David was afraid of God that day; he said, “How can I bring the ark of God into my care? ”
text_cn: 那天，达味对天主害了怕，心想：“我怎能将天主的约柜运到我那里？”

text_en: So David did not take the ark into his care into the city of David; he took it instead to the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.
text_cn: 因此，达味没有把约柜运往达味城他自己那里，转运至加特人敖贝得厄东家。

text_en: The ark of God remained with the household of Obed-edom in his house three months, and the Lord blessed the household of Obed-edom and all that he had.
text_cn: 天主的约柜在敖贝得厄东家中存放了三个月；上主祝福了敖贝得厄东的家和他的一切所有。
